image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a weathered log in a forest setting. The amphibian displays characteristic glossy black skin with irregular, vivid yellow spots and bands covering its back, head, and limbs. The background consists of green foliage and brown leaf litter.
